title: DeepHateExplainer: Explainable Hate Speech Detection in Under-resourced Bengali Language
findings: The proposed ensemble model, DeepHateExplainer, effectively detects religious hate speech in Bengali with an F1-score of 84%. The study identified key terms used in religious hate speech (e.g., Islam, Malaun, Hindu, Muslim, Jihadi) and demonstrated the model's ability to provide term-level explanations for its classification decisions, enhancing transparency.
